scientific_integrity: Explicit nine-dimensional construction, exact algebraic proof of saturation, universal complete-MUB lower bound from established second-moment identity.
scientific_limitations: Only the standard finite-field complete MUB family is shown to attain the lower bound. No global equality classification or universal attainment by inequivalent MUB sets is claimed. Literature-priority risk remains.
title: A sharp dimension-nine MUB support law and an equal-probability balanced state
